$comment: Advisories that `node scripts/audit.js` may accept without failing, grouped by install directory.
Every entry needs a reason explaining why a patched version cannot be resolved.
The audit fails when an accepted advisory is no longer reported, so stale entries cannot linger.
`level` is the lowest severity that fails for that directory. Shipped code is audited below `high`.

allow.reason: Patched in 7.0.3, but mocha declares serialize-javascript@^6.0.2 and cannot resolve 7.x. The vulnerable path is limited to Mocha's dev-only test metadata until Mocha widens its dependency range.
